lines.say: The weather server stopped answering for one second. Then thousands of apps tried again at the same moment, and it went down for real.
lines.show: The weather server stopped answering for *one second.* Then thousands of apps tried again at the same moment, and it [went down for real.]

lines.say: Retrying means trying again. It helps when a connection drops for a moment.
lines.show: Retrying means *trying again.* It helps when a connection [drops for a moment.]

lines.say: But thousands of apps trying again instantly, over and over, can overwhelm the server. That's a retry storm.
lines.show: But thousands of apps trying again *instantly,* over and over, can overwhelm the server. That's a [retry storm.]

lines.say: Fix one: stop when it works, or after three retries.
lines.show: Fix one: stop when it works, or [after three retries.]

lines.say: Fix two: wait longer each time. One second, then two, then four, so the server can recover.
lines.show: Fix two: [wait longer] each time. One second, then two, then four, so the server can *recover.*

lines.say: Fix three: add a little randomness to each wait, so the apps don't all come back together.
lines.show: Fix three: add a little [randomness] to each wait, so the apps don't all *come back together.*

lines.say: If you're a vibe coder, follow for the system design your AI skipped.
lines.show: If you're a vibe coder, follow for the system design your AI [skipped.]
